idea_name: Feature-driven virtual qubit circuit with volatility-scaled decoherence
mechanism: BuildQuantumCircuit maps features to rotation angles and CPhase entanglement from feature correlations; Hadamard superposition probability rises with CalculateMarketUncertainty; ApplyEnvironmentalDecoherence scales phase noise by recent volatility and information flow; MeasureQuantumState yields per-qubit |1> probabilities fed into hybrid Markov/SSM/transformer pipeline.
data_needed: normalized feature vector; NUM_QUBITS=3 STATE_DIM=8; volatility and information-intensity estimates
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: live EA claims 2024-2025 results; architecture is instrument-agnostic
why_new_for_mis: Treats market features as parameters of a simulated quantum preprocessor whose decoherence rate itself is a volatility sensor.
quote: During calm periods, quantum effects persist longer, while during market turmoil the system quickly switches to classical behavior.

idea_name: U-Transformer trained on linear AR residuals with R2-adaptive blend
mechanism: 25-feature linear AR (lags, quadratic, momentum, sin/cos cycles, hour/24, RSI, ATR interactions) fit by gradient descent; U-Transformer learns residuals; Final=Linear+neural_weight*UT where neural_weight=(1-min(R2,0.8)) when trained; UT preferred when loss<0.01 else linear backup gated by R2>0.1.
data_needed: H1 closes for analyst_symbol; OptimizationBars sliding window; 25-D features per bar
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: analyst vs trade symbols (e.g. EURUSD analyze / USDJPY trade); PERIOD_H1
why_new_for_mis: Residual nonlinear sensor only activates when linear fit is weak—natural regime switch between linear and neural sensing.
quote: with a high R² of the linear component (good quality), the neural network component receives less weight; with a low R², it receives more weight. This ensures the system's stability in various market regimes

idea_name: Parafrac oscillator momentum-strength threshold on PSAR-price gap
mechanism: Parafrac normalizes PSAR-price gap by fractal range; V2 by ATR; Strategy1 requires zero-line cross plus oscillator magnitude beyond threshold4Strat1—threshold filters momentum strength of the PSAR break rather than direction alone.
data_needed: PSAR (pstep,pMax); ATR period for V2; oscillator buffers/histograms
why_new_for_mis: Explicit momentum-strength sensor on PSAR-price gap, with ATR vs fractal normalization as alternative scale choices.
quote: the core value of this indicator setup is not in identifying the trend direction (which the base PSAR already does) but in quantifying the strength of the momentum behind the trend break.

mechanism: OnTick trade manager moves SL to BE, trails, partial closes by points—execution management not market sensing.
why_new_for_mis: Trade management chrome after full read.
quote: The EA handles three essential aspects of trade management: automatically moving the stop-loss to break-even to prevent losses, trailing the stop-loss levels as the price moves in favor of a position, and closing partial profits

mechanism: EAState struct saved via FileWriteStruct/LoadState across restarts—infrastructure for counters/streaks, not sensing.
quote: This article presents a framework for state serialization using native MQL5 binary file operations.

mechanism: CEventBus routes ENUM_EA_EVENT payloads between signal/order/drawdown modules—architecture decoupling.
quote: The CEventBus architecture replaces an implicit, fragile network of global variables with an explicit, compiler-enforced communication contract.

mechanism: HistorySelect previous D1 window; aggregate profit/wins/losses; SendMail once per day—reporting not sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: account-wide; D1 boundaries via iTime PERIOD_D1
quote: we will build a system that automates the generation of daily trading reports directly from MetaTrader 5.

idea_name: Timestamp-aligned multi-symbol OHLC average custom symbol
mechanism: BuildAveragedRates matches bars by open time across N symbols; synthetic OHLC = mean of aligned OHLC; volume average or sum; CustomRatesUpdate builds continuous index-like series for charting/testing.
data_needed: OHLC+tick_volume from 2–3 source symbols with overlapping sessions
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: examples EURUSD+GBPUSD(+XAUUSD); user TF; InpBarsToCalculate history
why_new_for_mis: Constructs a collective-market price sensor (correlation/index style) from equal-weight multi-symbol averaging.
quote: This produces a normalized synthetic candle that reflects the general price movement across all selected markets instead of a single instrument.

idea_name: Live stream of filter slope, whipsaw flips, lag, equity, spread
mechanism: LiveCSVStreamer buffers bar/tick rows with filter_value, filter_slope∈{-1,0,1}, cumulative false_flips, avg_lag_bars, session_equity, spread_points; Python daemon alerts on high recent whipsaw density and rolling equity drawdown %.
data_needed: live EMA (or host filter) + OHLC/tick; Common Files CSV rotation by UTC day
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: demo LiveStream_Indicator any symbol/TF (ETHUSD M1 naming example)
why_new_for_mis: Operational signal-quality and liquidity-adjacent (spread) sensors streamed for real-time MIS monitoring.
quote: Signal anomalies — such as sudden spikes in whipsaw frequency or a sharp deterioration in rolling equity — are flagged to a separate alert log.

series_key: creating an ea that works automatically
idea_name: Order system vs trigger system EA structure primer
mechanism: Conceptual split of order management vs trigger; MetaEditor scaffold OnInit/OnTick—no sensor formulas.
quote: the EA has two internal structures: the order system, which will always be the same for all EA, and the second structure, the trigger system

idea_name: UT Bot Alerts EA with ATR volatility stops on confirmed bar
mechanism: Reads UT Bot buy/sell buffers at index 1 on new bar; optional SL from ATR[1]*stopAtrMultiplier; TP from risk*rewardRiskRatio—ATR as volatility-scaled protective distance.
data_needed: ciw_uTBotAlerts buffers; iATR; confirmed closed bar
why_new_for_mis: Standard ATR stop sizing tied to UT Bot signal—limited new sensing beyond volatility-scaled risk distance.
quote: When active, stop-loss levels are calculated from the Average True Range of the most recently closed bar, which provides a volatility-based risk measure that adapts to market conditions.
